item.title: Sarasota police officers receive Life Saver Awards
item.description: The Sarasota Police Department has honored several officers with Life Saver Awards for their actions in 2025. Just prior to 11 p.m. on April 29, 2025, while on bike patrol Officer Ryan Howell encountered a man who had climbed onto the outside of the John Ringling Causeway railing and was threatening to jump. item.title: Manatee County Commissioner Carol Felts dies at 68
item.description: Manatee County Commissioner Carol Ann Felts, 68, has died.Felts was found outside her home Tuesday afternoon by her aide, Selena Cunningham, who went to Felts’ home in Myakka City for their afternoon work session. The last time Cunningham spoke to Felts was around 10 a.m. that morning. A cause of death has not been determined. The Manatee County Sheriff’s Office was on the scene investigating. item.title: Longboat's mayor reflects on big decisions, gives advice to commission
item.description: Longboat Key Mayor Ken Schneier and his wife, Cynthia Craig, moved to Longboat Key from New Jersey in 2009. Schneier was elected to the Town Commission in 2018 and started his tenure as mayor during an uncertain and worrying time: March 2020. With the entire nation coming to grips with a global pandemic that would change the way of life for months and years, Schneier remembers trying to navigate the pandemic locally. item.title: FDOT prefers fixed-span design for Longboat Pass Bridge replacement
item.description: Leaving Longboat Key from the northern end will look much different in the coming years as two bridges on that route are set to be replaced.One, though — the Cortez Bridge — is a lot further along in the replacement process than the other. item.title: Sarasota wraps up two-day city manager interview process
item.description: A whirlwind two days of activity wrapped up Tuesday afternoon for the five finalist candidates for the position of Sarasota city manager. item.title: Late-night cookie chain opens its first store in Sarasota
item.description: If you ever find yourself with a midnight craving, a new expansion of a bakery chain to Sarasota may cater to your sweet tooth. Insomnia Cookies has opened its first store in Sarasota, located at 2264 Gulf Gate Drive. The bakery is open until late at night, at times ranging from 1 a.m. to 3 a.m. While it offers in-store pickup, it is also known for its late-night delivery options.
